data.summary: configwrite._toml_literal (also review._toml_value, companions json.dumps path) quotes strings with json.dumps(ensure_ascii=True), which writes a character outside the BMP (e.g. an emoji) as a UTF-16 surrogate pair \ud83d\ude80; TOML \u escapes must be Unicode scalar values, so tomllib refuses the file. Probe 2026-10-05: tomllib.loads('x = ' + _toml_literal('ship it 🚀')) -> TOMLDecodeError 'Escaped character is not a Unicode scalar value'. So 'ddflow config <key> <value with emoji>' writes a config that no later command can read. Fix: one TOML basic-string writer (ensure_ascii=False, escape U+007F) used by every writer.
data.title: TOML string writers emit surrogate escapes for non-BMP characters, producing unparseable TOML

data.body:
Fixes bug Bb11e7a8186: configwrite._toml_literal (also review._toml_value, companions json.dumps path) quotes strings with json.dumps(ensure_ascii=True), which writes a character outside the BMP (e.g. an emoji) as a UTF-16 surrogate pair \ud83d\ude80; TOML \u escapes must be Unicode scalar values, so tomllib refuses the file. Probe 2026-10-05: tomllib.loads('x = ' + _toml_literal('ship it 🚀')) -> TOMLDecodeError 'Escaped character is not a Unicode scalar value'. So 'ddflow config <key> <value with emoji>' writes a config that no later command can read. Fix: one TOML basic-string writer (ensure_ascii=False, escape U+007F) used by every writer.

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-Bb11e7a8186 --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed Bb11e7a8186 --regression-test <test>` first).
data.title: Fix bug Bb11e7a8186: TOML string writers emit surrogate escapes for non-BMP characters, producing unparseable TOML

data.claim: No: _toml_literal (json.dumps, ensure_ascii=True) is not a correct TOML string writer for arbitrary text: it leaves values like 'true' or '[x]' unquoted, and writes non-BMP chars as surrogate pairs TOML refuses; json.dumps(ensure_ascii=False) plus escaping U+007F round-trips every string.
data.falsifier: tomllib.loads('x = '+_toml_literal('ship it 🚀')) parses, or json.dumps(s, ensure_ascii=False) round-trips U+007F
data.mechanism: TOML \u escapes must be Unicode scalar values; TOML forbids raw U+007F in basic strings; _toml_literal passes through anything that looks like a TOML literal
data.probe: uv run python -c tomllib.loads('x = '+_toml_literal('ship it 🚀')); and json.dumps(ch, ensure_ascii=False) for 🚀, \x7f, é
data.probe_output: _toml_literal: ERR Escaped character is not a Unicode scalar value (line 1 col 20). ensure_ascii=True: 🚀 ERR, \x7f ok; ensure_ascii=False: 🚀 ok, \x7f ERR Illegal character. Unfixed Rule.to_toml: 10 of 16 round-trip cases failed (TOMLDecodeError line 2 col 15 for say "hi").
data.question: Can configwrite._toml_literal be reused as the escaper for Rule.to_toml string fields?

evidence.note: research R3fb6446bee CONFIRMED: _toml_literal is not reusable (surrogate escapes, passes through 'true'); json.dumps(ensure_ascii=False)+U+007F escape round-trips; failing run of tests/test_rules_toml_escape.py on unfixed code: 10 failed, 6 passed
